notes.rationale: sich schämen is lexically reflexive: the sense needs sich coreferent with Mara, and no other object can stand in its place, so sich is a member of the verb's target and part of the normalized Surface schämt sich (de/verb-owns-its-scattered-members). Its lexicallyReflexive is Acc, as in ich schäme mich (de/verb-core-features). für is governed: E-VALBU has no schämen entry, so Duden decides, and it gives ich schäme mich für dich; DWDS lists sich für etwas schämen beside the elevated sich einer Sache schämen. für + Acc names what one is ashamed of, as the genitive object does, so für is a member recorded in valencyEvidence as für + Acc and stays out of the normalized Surface, as an does for sich erinnern (de/governed-preposition-joins-its-governor). den Irrtum fills the slot and stays outside.
